comment: Known advisories, production and dev, signed off with a review deadline. scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails CI on any high/critical advisory missing here, on any entry audit no longer reports, and on any entry past its reviewBy date. `reviewBy: null` means informational only — no deadline, never gating.

advisories.reason: No patched release exists at any version, so there is nothing to upgrade to; npm can only offer a semver-major downgrade of jest. Reachable only through jest's devDependency tree (jest-config → deepmerge), never in a shipped build. Re-check by 2027-02-10: by then a patched release may exist, or jest may have taken a major that drops deepmerge.
